newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: News on track for 20 pct profit rise - Murdoch.
newsitem.headline: News on track for 20 pct profit rise - Murdoch.

text.p: News Corp Ltd chief executive and chairman Rupert Murdoch said in a newspaper interview published on Friday that News was still on track for a 20 percent increase in profit in the current 1996/97 year.

"If the American economy holds where it is and the British one does, yes certainly (the 20 percent increase is attainable)," Murdoch told News Corp's Courier Mail newspaper in an interview. News Corp said after its 1995/96 results in late August that a 20 percent profit rise was very attainable.
"But it is still early days to be saying that," the newspaper quoted Murdoch as saying.
